decisions.reason: Having survived its first review and fitting the firm's engineered demanding-environment niche, the naval vessel line would likely be kept while management tolerates long specialist procurement cycles unless results clearly fall below aspiration.

The desk lamp is more peripheral to the firm's systems-led strategic direction, but as a large firm with some slack and an ergonomic office-lighting fit, management would more likely keep it one more year while judging whether performance reaches acceptable levels.
This general interior luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core building-lighting business and the G2 continuity suggests results are likely close enough to aspiration to justify retention.
Because this pendant luminaire was presented as a flagship aligned with the firm's strategic move toward advanced efficient lighting, management would be very unlikely to withdraw it so soon.
After dropping the HMI searchlight, management would likely retain this marine searchlight as the stronger remaining marine offer unless its niche demand now proves materially below aspiration.
